label: PF Backlog 50
title: Fix store-registry drift: unregistered live stores, portfolio.db/queue.db path, factory_context naming
body:
Code sweep found registry drift that must be fixed backend-first:
1) UNREGISTERED LIVE STORES: products/index.json (writer core/global_orchestrator.py:89, scripts/pipeline_helpers.py:30) and products/queue.json (writer core/queue_manager.py:59, scripts/pipeline.py:770) have no store-registry entry, no API route and no dashboard item.
2) DB PATH MISMATCH: registry entry for portfolio.db says 'moved -> product-forge/portfolio/queue.db' but the file is still portfolio.db and queue.db does not exist; the live queue is products/queue.json.
3) NAMING: product_forge_context/factory_context.json contains the FORBIDDEN token 'factory' and is the wrong filename vs what the router reads (product_forge_context/product_forge_context.json).
4) UNREGISTERED PROJECT DIRS: products/<project>/{memory/, compliance/, approvals/} hold data with no registered store.
Fix: add missing registry entries (or fold), correct the DB path/name, rename+clean the context file, and extend wired_audit's factory check to cover these paths.

decisions.note: [P1] Foundational: fix store-registry drift so the truths are correct before anything reads them.
